checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.placeholder: Check-ins arrive in a later phase. You'll choose how often to check in, and what happens if you stop.

empty.title: Set up your legacy
empty.body: Add your first recipient and write what you want them to receive. Everything is encrypted before it leaves this device.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your vault key has been re-secured under the new password.
changePassword.vaultLocked: Unlock your vault first — changing the password re-encrypts your vault key.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.explain: Add a 6-digit code from an authenticator app to every sign-in.
twoFactor.scan: Add this secret to your authenticator app, then enter the current code to confirm.
twoFactor.backupExplain: Each code works once, if you lose your authenticator. Save them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.

sessions.title: Devices & sessions
sessions.revokeCurrentNeedsPassword: Enter your password to sign out this device.

recoveryKey.title: Recovery Key
recoveryKey.explain: Issue a new Recovery Key. Your old key stops working immediately.
recoveryKey.vaultLocked: Unlock your vault first — issuing a new key requires re-encrypting your vault key.
